title: a new deferral with no open record id
how: a deferral phrase (for now, stop-gap, interim, temporarily, remove once / when / after, in a later stage, comes later, not yet built, until then, slice / stage B-Z) in a comment or a string must cite a record id (RM- DEC- DIR- Q-) that resolves to an open item; quoted text is not read

explain.what: A comment or a string defers work (for now, interim, stop-gap, remove once, in a later stage) and cites no open record.
explain.why: A deferral with no record is forgotten. The temporary code becomes permanent.
explain.fix: Cite the open record that tracks the work (RM-n, DEC-n, DIR-n or Q-n), or add one. Or do the work now and delete the words.
